mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate directly reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.5%, it triggers a hawkish monetary policy response that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.5% (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate earnings growth slows, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 20d returns in more than 40% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a simultaneous increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 200k per month signals a strong labor market that fuels consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS > 200, SPX fails to produce positive 20d returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth does not correlate with positive 20d SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the quarterly real GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeds 2.0% (annualized), it signals strong economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 QoQ growth > 2.0% does not lead to positive 60d SPX returns in at least 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%), a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5.0% triggers a monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, SPX fails to produce negative 20d returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4.5%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 4.5% does not lead to negative 5d SPX returns in at least 60% of cases.
